extracted.intended_audience: researchers and authors preparing or revising manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for researchers on how to handle peer review: understanding what reviewers and editors look for, how to critically self-review a manuscript, and how to prepare an appropriate response letter to move a submission through the publishing process.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to respond to reviewers' comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical advice on how to respond to reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers the initial steps you should take after receiving reviewer comments and the correct tone and language to use in your response letter; aims to help keep your submission moving smoothly through the publishing process. (Module: 37 m webinar.)

rubrics_metrics.name: What reviewers are looking for
rubrics_metrics.description: An explanation of what reviewers are looking for when they evaluate a manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps authors see their manuscript through the eyes of a reviewer so they can anticipate concerns and address them; presented as a module to explain reviewers' evaluation priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: How do editors look at your paper?
rubrics_metrics.description: Understanding the editor's perspective on a submission and editorial priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aims to show authors how editors assess papers so authors can align submissions with editorial expectations and spot issues an editor might raise. (Module: 31 m webinar.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial steps after receiving reviewer comments
rubrics_metrics.description: The immediate actions authors should take when they get reviewer feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentioned as part of the response guidance; implies organizing comments, deciding on revisions, and preparing an appropriate reply to keep the review process progressing. (Specific step-by-step details are provided in the module.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct tone and language for the response letter
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of appropriate tone and wording when writing the response to reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes constructive, professional language and tone in the response letter to facilitate productive interaction with reviewers and editors; guidance and examples provided in the module.

rubrics_metrics.name: Critical self-review to spot shortfalls and mistakes before submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Tips on looking at your submission with a critical eye to identify shortfalls or mistakes prior to submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages authors to pre-empt reviewer/editor criticisms by reviewing their own manuscript for common problems and weaknesses before submitting.
